text: They gave good advice and were easy to contact.

Everything was great – the nurses, the staff, the atmosphere, the weather – but the wait was a bit long. It's a shame… if this were the last thing to do for the day, it would have been more relaxing and I could have waited longer. My heart rate was 200 BPM while waiting… I was worried I wouldn't make it to the next task on time.😅 …
The explanation was good, the work was fast, and the nurse was very kind.
We went to the family department on the 2nd floor. Everyone was lovely. They gave good advice and provided good service and assistance to patients. They were attentive and spoke very politely.

Even the parking lot wasn't provided; we had to find our own parking in the side streets or near the Lotus store. They didn't tell us beforehand that parking wasn't allowed. We parked and got out of the car before they finally told us, and even then, they told us to back out ourselves without even helping us watch our backs up. This is the ultimate in public service. I didn't dare go up there for treatment because I was afraid of having an even worse "impression."
The staff were lovely and provided excellent service.
